name: Genghis Khan's war on Khwarazm
summary: When the governor of Otrar kills a Mongol trade caravan and the shah has his envoys put to death, Genghis Khan leads perhaps 100,000 horsemen west. In two years the Khwarazmian empire falls: Bukhara, Samarkand, Balkh and the cities of Khorasan are taken, and the shah's son Jalal al-Din is driven to the Indus. The steppe now reaches the lands of Islam.

stops.note: The army gathers on the Irtysh after the murder of the envoys.
Besieged for five months; the governor who killed the caravan is put to death.
Juvaini has the khan tell its people he is the punishment of God.
The shah's capital surrenders after a few days.
His grandson is killed in the siege, and the valley is laid waste.
Jalal al-Din spurs his horse into the river and escapes to India.
He winters here, and summons the Daoist master Changchun.
Home to the steppe after six years.
